_why: Read by scripts/bundle_exercise_images.py (NO_PICTURE, ACCEPTED_SHARED_FRAMES), by scripts/generate_free_exercise_library.mjs (noPicture) and by tests/lib/exerciseImagesBundled.test.cjs. free-exercise-db reuses one photo for several different exercises. A frame that shows another movement than the exercise's own steps is worse than none, so those keys ship no picture (owner decision 2026-10-09) and the app shows its placeholder. Two keys may share a frame only when it is a fair picture of both, and each such group is named here.
